entities.summary: Johann(es) Schreck, also Terrenz or Terrentius Constantiensis, Deng Yuhan Hanpo (鄧玉函), Deng Zhen Lohan was a German Jesuit, missionary to China and polymath. He is credited with the development of scientific-technical terminology in Chinese.
